about: Test lines of the FE options file parse, shared by the page (tools/zakuro-options patch 0002, fe_options::parse) and the readable library's reader (src/readable/core/options.c). expect = [danger_zone, hp_bars, animation_skip, anim_speed]. Checked by src/readable/menu/tests/w12_diff.py (--options). Made-up text only.

cases.why: patch 0002 test: the game lines take their list length
patch 0002 test: past the list, negative, a word, past the list: the game's choice
patch 0001 test: a missing (empty) file is all off
patch 0002 render: the page's own file form
cases.text:
# FE options. 0 is off, and off is the original game.
stance_forecast = 0
growth_display = 0
vein_highlight = 0
danger_zone = 2
hp_bars = 1
animation_skip = 1
anim_speed = 3
dual_strike = 0
dual_guard = 0
death_rule = 0

cases.why: patch 0002 test: slot blocks are not sections for parse; game lines read anywhere
the last of two equal keys wins
a bad last value wins too (it gives 0)
u8 parse: one leading plus, leading zeros
u8 parse: a lone plus, minus zero, empty, 256, a fullwidth digit
no spaces, tabs, CRLF line ends
Unicode white space is trimmed (NBSP, ideographic space)
U+001C is not white space for Rust (it is for Python's strip)
a byte order mark stays part of the first key
a comment line and a trailing comment (the value is then not a number)
split at the first '=' only
keys are exact (case, near names)
a line without '=' and unknown keys are ignored
not valid UTF-8: the whole file is empty
an encoded surrogate is not UTF-8
an overlong form is not UTF-8
a lone CR inside a line is trimmed at its ends
